response.overview: In the heart of a futuristic metropolis, "Chlorophyll" unveils the captivating journey of Jonathan, a man who finds solace amidst the chaos through his intimate connection with nature. As Jonathan grapples with the overwhelming presence of towering skyscrapers and incessant advertisements, his tender care for a single potted plant becomes a poignant symbol of his longing for authenticity in a world dominated by artificiality.
response.title: CHLOROPHYLL
